_meta.description: English source strings for Infinity Mod Runner UI translation.

app.title: Infinity Mod Runner
welcome.title: Welcome to Infinity Mod Runner
welcome.intro: This tool installs Baldur's Gate, Icewind Dale, and Planescape Torment mods from a list you build in Infinity Mod Forge (the web app). Runner doesn't pick mods for you — it drives WeiDU through a plan Forge exported.
welcome.need_game_dir: Your game directory (BG1:EE or BG2:EE, minimum)
welcome.need_mod_dir: A folder of extracted mods (each in its own subfolder, containing a .tp2 file)
welcome.need_weidu_log: A WeiDU.log exported from Infinity Mod Forge
banner.setup_done_body: Import your mod list below to continue.
banner.preflight_passed_body: You're ready to install. Want to preview the plan first?
setup.heading: Setup
setup.desc: Configure your game directories and tool paths. These are saved automatically.
setup.locked: Settings are locked while an install is running
setup.chitin_not_found: chitin.key not found — is this the right directory?
setup.fresh_install_detail: Fresh install — dialog.tlk {mb} MB, override/ has {count} files
setup.freshness.weidu_log_found: weidu.log found with {count} mod entries — this game has been modded
setup.freshness.override_count_high: override/ contains {count} files (fresh installs have very few)
setup.freshness.setup_scripts_found: Setup-*.exe files found — mod installers have been run here
setup.mod_dir_hint: Directory containing extracted mod folders (each with a .tp2 file)
setup.forge_explainer: Not sure where to start? Build your mod list in Infinity Mod Forge and export a WeiDU.log — that's what Runner imports next.
setup.advanced_hint: Forge URL override and data directory
setup.guided_mode_desc: Locks tabs in order and adds "Next" buttons at the bottom of each step. Recommended if this is your first install — turn off any time to switch to free navigation.
install.guided_dry_hint: Recommended first step — previews the install plan without touching your game directory.
setup.no_mods_found: No mods found. Mods must be extracted (unzipped) here, each in its own subfolder.
setup.weidu_not_detected: Not detected — browse to select manually
setup.forge_url_hint: URL where Infinity Mod Forge is hosted. Used for pre-flight checks and debug matching.
setup.data_dir_hint: Where Infinity Mod Runner stores install logs, checkpoints, and backups. Leave empty to use the default (next to the exe).
setup.data_dir_open_hint: Open the resolved data directory in the OS file manager
exp_weidu.modal_enable_title: Use the patched WeiDU for installs?
exp_weidu.modal_disable_title: Switch back to your configured WeiDU?
exp_weidu.modal_how_text: Enabling this only flips a setting. At install start, Infinity Mod Runner extracts the bundled patched binary into its own data directory and invokes that path instead of your configured weidu_path. Your game directory is not modified, and your configured WeiDU binary is untouched. Disabling returns the next install to using your configured binary.
exp_weidu.modal_ack: I understand this is experimental, replaces the WeiDU binary used by the installer, and is not supported by WeiDU authors.
exp_weidu.modal_disable_text: Your next install will use the WeiDU binary configured in Setup. The cached patched binary can be re-enabled at any time — no reinstall of Infinity Mod Runner needed.
exp_weidu.modal_disable_caveat: If you have an install in progress, it will keep using whichever binary it started with — the switch only affects the NEXT install.
mods.heading: Mods
mods.empty_body: Runner needs a WeiDU.log describing which mods to install and in what order. You get one from Infinity Mod Forge — build your list there, click Export, and import the resulting WeiDU.log here.
mods.locked: Install in progress — mod list is locked
mods.import_desc: Import the WeiDU.log files exported from Infinity Mod Forge. The EET log is required. The BG1:EE log is optional (only needed if your install has a BG1 phase).
mods.import_first: Import WeiDU logs above to see your mod list.
mods.report_tooltip: Open a GitHub issue to report a bad link, wrong version, or other Forge data problem for this mod
ready.heading: Ready Check
ready.desc: Environment health check — paths, WeiDU, mod folders, junction capability, disk space, Forge compatibility, patches, and backup. Run this before a Dry Run preview.
ready.locked: Install in progress — checks are paused
ready.import_first: Import a WeiDU.log first (Mods tab) before running the ready check.
ready.empty_body: Import a mod list in the Mods tab first. Once you have one, this tab will validate mod presence, engine limits, known issues, and scan for applicable patches.
ready.override_risks: I understand the risks and want to proceed anyway
install.open_install_folder_hint: Open the per-game data folder (install.log, reports, checkpoint)
ready.rescan_orphans_hint: Refresh the orphan count without re-running the full Ready Check. Useful after a backup restore.
ready.banner_blocked_sub: {err} blocking, {ok} passed — resolve errors before proceeding
install.prefs_save_hint: Snapshot these install options as your personal preferences. Stored in your config file; survives restart.
install.prefs_restore_hint: Load the preferences you previously saved.
install.prefs_restore_disabled: No preferences saved yet — click "Save my preferences" first.
install.prefs_reset_hint: Discard current options and return to the conservative program defaults.
install.prefs_reset_body: This will discard your current install options and revert them to the conservative program defaults. Any settings that don't exactly match the defaults will be overwritten.
install.prefs_reset_note_saved: Note: your saved preferences are untouched — you can click "Restore my preferences" to get them back anytime.
install.prefs_reset_note_unsaved: You have no saved preferences, so this reset cannot be undone with one click. If you want your current settings back, cancel and click "Save my preferences" first.
install.prefs_parse_error: Saved preferences were corrupted — could not restore
install.prefs_hint_has_saved: Your preferences are saved and will load on next launch.
install.prefs_hint_unsaved: Changes live in config — save as preferences to carry them across resets.
debug.drop_path_hint: Usually found at: %USERPROFILE%\Saved Games\Baldur's Gate II - Enhanced Edition\WSETUP.DEBUG — or in a mod's folder as Setup-<modname>.debug
mods.dep_tip_autoskip: Auto-skipped. Click Include anyway to override.
mods.dep_include_hint: Override the mod author's deprecation and install this component anyway
tab.status_desc.warn: Completed with warnings — review before installing
tab.status_desc.err: Errors reported — check the details in this tab
install.slow_tip_scanning_desc: {mod} does large full-game file iterations — quiet phases are expected, not a hang.
install.slow_tip_cascade_desc: Per-minute line rate is falling across recent samples — typically SFO memory-pressure as override/ grows. Consider enabling Redirect override to fast drive.
install.slow_tip_slow_desc: This batch has been running longer than the heuristic threshold. Not necessarily broken — some heavy mods legitimately take minutes.
install.bcs_tip_active_desc: Per-process stats from the last batch's WeiDU exit. Higher hit rate = more reuse of parsed BCS between components.
install.bcs_tip_cold_desc: The last batch didn't touch any BCS resources, so the cache had nothing to serve. Expected on non-scripting mods.
install.bcs_tip_disabled_desc: WEIDU_BCS_CACHE_MB=0 — the patched cache is off for this run. Useful as an A/B baseline; otherwise consider enabling it for faster BCS-heavy installs.
install.bcs_card_evictions_hint: budget pressure — consider raising cache size
install.bcs_card_disabled_desc: WEIDU_BCS_CACHE_MB=0 — {n} batch(es) ran without the BCS buffer cache.
install.eta_tooltip: Estimate based on smoothed throughput; heavy mods ahead can still shift this significantly
install.eta_heavy_pending: Heavy mods pending — ETA includes their longer baselines:
install.eta_unreliable: Heavy mod in progress — ETA is frozen because current throughput isn't representative of the rest of the install
install.save_trace_hint: Save per-component timing JSON next to the install report. Contributes to ETA accuracy improvements.
install.share_trace_hint: Copies anonymized trace to clipboard and opens GitHub. Paste and submit to help improve ETA baselines.
ready.select_none_sticky_hint: 'None' leaves required patches selected — they can't be bulk-deselected.
backup.create_hint: Create a selective backup of the current game directory
backup.empty_desc: A backup snapshots the current game state so you can roll back. Selective backups skip install side-folders to save space.
backup.mode_selective_desc: Backs up chitin.key, override/, and top-level IDS/BCS files. Skips mod side-folders that get installed fresh. Fast; restore rolls back install damage without touching mod source.
backup.mode_full_desc: Copies the entire game directory verbatim. Slow and large, but captures everything — use when you've made manual edits you want to preserve across installs.
backup.estimate_failed: Couldn't estimate size — check backup location.
backup.not_enough_space: Not enough free space — pick a different backup location or free some up.
backup.tight_space: Barely fits — less than 10% margin. Consider freeing space first.
backup.orphaned_tooltip: Backups for games you haven't configured. Can be deleted but not restored until you add the matching game to Setup.
backup.orphaned_warn: These backups reference games not currently in your Setup. Add the matching game path to Setup before restoring, or delete them to reclaim space.
backup.verify_hint: Compare manifest file count + size against what's actually on disk. Catches truncated or partially-deleted backups before you try to restore.
backup.no_game_dir: No game directory configured for {game}. Set it in Setup.
setup.additional_games_hint: For cross-game mods — backup / restore coverage only
install.log_fit_hint: Resize the log to ~75% of the window
install.log_reset_hint: Reset log height to the default
install.heading: Install Runner
install.desc: Execute or preview your mod install via WeiDU. Dry Run simulates the install plan (batching, ordering, timing); Start Installation runs it for real with live progress, retry, and pause points. Run Ready Check first for environment validation.
install.no_weidu: WeiDU path not configured. Set it in the Setup tab.
install.no_log: No log imported. Import a WeiDU.log first.
install.precond_weidu: Configure the WeiDU binary in Setup
install.precond_mod_list: Import a mod list in the Mods tab
install.group_behavior_desc: How the installer reacts to warnings, errors, and already-installed components.
install.group_diag_desc: Detect corruption, surface hidden events, and avoid popup clutter during install.
install.group_perf_desc: Timeouts, batch size, override-redirect, and WeiDU tuning. Leave defaults unless you know you need to change them.
install.skip_installed_hint: Resume interrupted installs without repeating successful mods
install.never_abort_hint: Recommended for large installs — keeps going and reports at the end
install.abort_warnings_hint: Stop the install on any warning, not just errors
install.auto_skip_hint: Automatically retry then skip errors — no interactive prompts
install.bcs_hint: Detect and restore WeiDU round-trip corruption in script files
install.guard_hint: Notify when a mod silently overwrites another mod's files (auto-restored either way)
install.suppress_hint: Prevent mods from opening documentation windows during install
install.timeout_hint: Kill a mod that stalls longer than this. Default 7200s = 2h.
install.batch_hint: Components per WeiDU call for non-heavy mods. Heavy mods (dw_talents, stratagems, mih_*, trap_overhaul) are always capped at 3. Lower values reduce blast radius on mid-batch failures.
install.fast_drive_hint: Junction game's override/ to a faster volume (NVMe or RAM disk) for the install. Can cut SFO-heavy mod time 2-5×. Needs ~3× override size free on target; target must be a different volume.
install.fast_drive_path_hint: Leave blank to use system temp. Path must be on a different volume than the game.
install.defender_exclusion: Auto-exclude game dir from Windows Defender
install.defender_exclusion_hint: Speeds up SFO-heavy mods 2–5× by skipping real-time scans. One UAC prompt at install start; the exclusion is permanent (remove via Windows Security if desired).
install.defender_exclusion_hint_inactive: Defender's real-time protection is disabled — a third-party AV is likely scanning instead. Enabling this won't help unless Defender becomes active again.
install.defender_exclusion_hint_unknown: Defender status couldn't be determined. Enable only if you know Defender is active on this machine; triggers one UAC prompt at install start.
install.language_hint: Passed to WeiDU as --language. Choose Other… to enter a custom locale code.
install.language_fallback_hint: Used when a mod doesn't provide translations for the primary language. Defaults to en_US because every EET-compatible mod ships with English.
install.pause_banner: Pause requested — will pause after the current mod finishes installing. This may take several minutes for large mods.
install.abort_banner: Abort signal sent — WeiDU will be force-killed in 3s if unresponsive...
install.unattempted_missing: mod not found or skipped entirely
install.telemetry_desc: Share anonymized install outcomes (mod IDs + pass/fail — no file paths or personal info) with the Infinity Engine community. Reports are submitted as GitHub Issues so you can see exactly what's shared.
install.no_backup_desc: It's recommended to create a backup before a multi-hour install. You can create one from the Ready Check tab, or continue without one.
backup.restore_desc: This will overwrite files in your current game directory. Changes since the backup was created will be lost.
preset.title: Browse Presets & Community Builds
preset.no_builds: No community builds yet. Create one in Infinity Mod Forge!
logs.panel_hint: Find, open, or share every log the app writes
logs.gui_log_desc: App lifecycle, config saves, errors, telemetry submissions. Spans sessions.
logs.install_log_desc: Per-install events — batches, errors, warnings, skips, BCS cache stats, PREBIFF markers. Appended per install.
logs.config_toml_desc: User configuration (game paths, install options, saved preferences). Written on every Save.
logs.reports_dir_desc: Structured post-install reports (install_report_*.json). Generated on demand via Save Report.
logs.guard_report_desc: Cross-mod file-corruption incidents, when File Guard fires during an install. Only present if a guard event occurred.
logs.checkpoint_desc: Resume state for interrupted installs. Cleared automatically on a successful complete.
logs.game_data_dir_desc: Folder holding install.log, reports, checkpoint, guard state, and other per-game artifacts. Hashed from your BG2 game path.
logs.app_config_root_desc: Tauri-standard config directory: gui.log, config.toml, and any rotated gui.log.* siblings.
logs.open_hint: Open in the OS file manager
logs.copy_hint: Copy the full path to the clipboard
logs.not_yet_present: not present — will be created when needed
logs.rotated_count: + {n} rotated gui.log file(s) in the app config folder
logs.share_bundle_hint: Package gui.log + install.log + reports + redacted config into a local zip, ready to attach to a forum post or help chat. No network upload.
logs.bundle_redacted: Redacted: game directory paths, mod directory, WeiDU binary, custom data directory, backup directories, override fast-drive path
debug.heading: Debug Analysis
debug.desc: Load a WeiDU debug log (WSETUP.DEBUG, Setup-*.debug) to diagnose installation issues. Handles files up to 500MB+.
debug.locked: Install in progress — debug analysis is paused
debug.drop_hint: Click to select a debug log file
debug.comparison_desc: Compare your Forge export against what actually installed to find discrepancies.
debug.gui_log_desc: Application-level log for diagnosing GUI issues and tracking install history.
defender.modal_title: Speed up this install with a Defender exclusion?
defender.modal_body_p1: Windows Defender's real-time scan runs on every file close — adding roughly 20 ms per operation. SFO-heavy mods (dw_talents, stratagems, mih_tweaks) run thousands of file ops per component, so Defender adds hours to big installs.
defender.modal_body_p2: Adding your game directory to Defender's exclusion list typically speeds those mods up 2–5×. The exclusion is permanent — we won't remove it afterward, so you only need to approve the UAC prompt once.
defender.modal_body_uac: You'll see one UAC prompt from Windows to authorize the change. You can remove the exclusion later via Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Manage settings → Exclusions.
defender.never_hint: Never show this prompt again. You can still enable auto-exclusion manually from Install → Advanced.
